«Юрта знаний» — серия настольно-дидактич: In Knowledge Yurt board games, children learn Bashkir and explore the culture of their homeland. The same idea works for any language or community. We’re looking for partners to create games for new regions.

Ребёнок не воспринимает игру как обязанн: To a child, a game is an adventure. Playing develops memory, attention, reasoning, observation and imagination while introducing the language, history and traditions of their own people and their neighbours.
Игры воспитывают культуру межнационально: Children learn to value other people’s traditions, make friends, treat each other as equals and help one another. The games encourage curiosity and respect for people from different backgrounds.
